release_notes: Attendance: face check-in is now instant - your punch shows on the dashboard the moment your face is verified and finishes in the background, pulsing until it confirms. Face recognition was upgraded with face alignment and stricter identity matching, so a shared account can no longer pass as several people; everyone re-enrols their face once after this update. Marketing: farms, dealers and markets all open with a search-first screen; sector is gone from the dealer, market and visit forms and markets are picked directly. Company lists now come from the central master, product company options follow the product category, and existing ERP dealers and plain farmers appear in their lists again. Records: dealer and farm pages have Visits and Follow-ups tabs, each scrolling on its own - tap a follow-up to mark it complete. Posting a dealer visit works again; it used to fail with a server error. Uploaded photos now appear on the lists and detail pages; tap any photo to open it full screen. Bookings: any employee can now post a feed or chicks booking - no sales account needed.
